name: raftkit
description: RaftLabs' private plugin marketplace — the RaftLabs way of shipping software, packaged for Claude Code and Claude apps.

plugins.name: raftkit-core
plugins.description: RaftKit rules (Asana constants, the one human stop per run, fetch-once live reads, Asana HTML, free tier, scope line, escalation, readiness, plain output), the RaftLabs working agreement and Module Design Standard, and usage telemetry hooks.

plugins.name: raftkit-pm
plugins.description: PM skills: the Project Profile, one story skill (author, amend, check, size), feature-list estimation, the weekly client update, meeting decisions, and routine handover — each with one stop before any write.

plugins.name: raftkit-dev
plugins.description: Developer skills: repo setup, story implementation, bug and incident fixes, scope audit, UI, Hasura migrations, and docs parity — one stop per run.

plugins.name: raftkit-qa
plugins.description: QA skills: the project test-case suite in a QA-owned Sheet, per-story run sheets, and one bug skill that files from Jam evidence and retests fixes — each with one stop before any write.

plugins.name: raftkit-docs
plugins.description: Opt-in documentation product: the co-authoring design flow, 29 adaptable templates, diagrams, reverse-engineering, scaffolding, and the project-local docs companion. Parity checks on a story stay in raftkit-dev.
